mapper.select: INSERT INTO public.nocode_business_counter(object_id, field_id, period_key, next_value, creator, updater) VALUES (#{object}, #{field}, #{period}, #{start}, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(object_id, field_id, period_key) DO UPDATE SET next_value = GREATEST(nocode_business_counter.next_value + 1, #{start}), updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp() RETURNING next_value

INSERT INTO public.nocode_business_counter(object_id, field_id, period_key, next_value, creator, updater) VALUES (#{object}, #{field}, #{period}, 1, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(object_id, field_id, period_key) DO UPDATE SET next_value = nocode_business_counter.next_value + 1, updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp() RETURNING next_value
